name: @local/freeform
description: Build forms, collect submissions, and send notifications directly from EmDash.

scripts.build: mkdir -p .tmp dist && TMPDIR="$(pwd)/.tmp" emdash-plugin build && tsdown src/index.ts src/native-entry.ts --format esm --outDir dist --dts false --no-clean --external emdash --external ../dist/plugin.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='dist/native-entry.js';fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replaceAll('../dist/plugin.mjs','./plugin.mjs'))"
scripts.build:watch: pnpm run build && tsdown src/index.ts src/native-entry.ts --format esm --outDir dist --dts false --no-clean --external emdash --external ../dist/plugin.mjs --watch
